title: Virtual and in-person follow-up on Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewals
content:
Patient Services Center desk guidance — Prescriptions & Renewals.

**Rule.** The follow-up adjustment on a controlled renewal combines virtual and in-person care with the prescribing department in the last 6 calendar months: where the patient completed a virtual visit and also a completed in-person visit with that department, it adds 1 fill; where the patient completed a virtual visit but no in-person visit with it, it takes away 1 fill; otherwise it changes nothing.

**Records read.**
- Virtual visits: the patient's Virtual Care visits with the department of the prescriber on this prescription, recorded as completed and scheduled within the 6 calendar months before the renewal date.
- In-person visits: the patient's In-Person Appointments with that department, recorded as completed and scheduled within the same 6 months.

**Combinations.**

| Completed Virtual Care visit with the department | Completed in-person visit with the department | Follow-up adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | adds 1 fill |
| yes | no | takes away 1 fill (-1) |
| no | yes | no change (0) |
| no | no | no change (0) |

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A video visit 2 months ago and an office visit 5 months ago, both with the prescribing department: adds 1 fill.
- Two phone visits with the prescribing department and no office visit in the 6 months: takes away 1 fill.
- An office visit only: no change.
